definitions.explanation: A chart or table laid out so that information can be found at a glance, such as conversions, fees, sizes, or schedules.

examples.japanese: {早見表|はやみひょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: Check it on the quick-reference chart.

examples.japanese: ⟦サイズ→サイズ：01363_saizu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{早見表|はやみひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んだ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: I chose clothes by looking at the size chart.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{早見表|はやみひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}えば→使う：00473_tsukau⟧、⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ひと{目|め}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: With this quick-reference chart, you can tell the fee at a glance.

notes:
Composed of {早見|はやみ} (seeing quickly) + ⟦{表|ひょう}→表：19354_hyou⟧ (table; chart). A ⟦{表|ひょう}→表：19354_hyou⟧ arranged so an answer can be found at a glance, without calculation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧{早見表|はやみひょう}: a fee quick-reference chart
- {早見表|はやみひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make a quick-reference chart
- {早見表|はやみひょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧: to look something up on a chart

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一覧表|いちらんひょう}→一覧表：22737_ichiranhyou⟧: a list/table — shows items together, not necessarily arranged for instant lookup
